caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device, primarily colored in shades of light brown and gray, that appears to be a sausage-making machine. The main body of the device is cylindrical and is shown open, with the top half of the cylinder hinged back to reveal the interior, which is lined with a series of teeth or blades. The lower half of the cylinder contains a matching row of metal teeth or blades fitted into the chamber, as well as a gear mechanism on the right side connected to a hand crank with a rounded handle. The device stands on two short, flat supports that provide stability, with the left support featuring an eyelet for mounting. In the upper right corner of the illustration, there is an inset sectional drawing, labeled “END OF BASE, SHOWING SAUSAGE VENT,” displaying the vent structure in cross-section. The overall image is outlined with a thin border and minimal background detail, and a signature with the year 1936 appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Sausage Grinder
